modelingNotes: Tasks are modeled as independent resource-allocation jobs because the current solver request does not support stage precedence.
Downtime windows are intentionally included for every major resource family to exercise gantt rendering and no-overlap constraints.
One pinned resource example and one pinned start example are included to exercise the current request schema.
